items.title: IWMI and IPCC to hold a Co-sponsored Expert Meeting to advance the science of water in climate change
items.description: COLOMBO, Sri Lanka, 8 September 2026 – The International Water Management Institute (IWMI) and the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change (IPCC) are bringing together experts at a co-sponsored meeting titled ‘Addressing Water Risks and Building Resilience to Climate Change: Evidence, Gaps and Policy Pathways’.
